## Design

### 2026-10-07 — Oct 6th (didn't have time to journal):

**2.5h**

Oct 6th (didn't have time to journal):
Did a lot of research into what materials I'll be using to create Megabot while downloading KiCad. As this is my first time creating a PCB, I used Claude for guidance through the entire KiCad download process and to fetch a variety of hardware I could be using and personally researched each one to see how they would all be incorporated into my design. I'll be using an ESP32-C3 for the brain, and be using a 1.28" round display for the face of Megabot! After KiCad finally downloaded on an older computer (my computer has far too little space), I realized the older version of KiCad that I downloaded for that macOS couldn't open the Seeed Xiao library I needed, so I'd have to use a Conn Pin and label it to the ESP32 pinout.
